items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: And Aime and I were great, great friends, when I first met him in 1935

ctx.x: He came back as a beaten soldier, more or less. He had nothing and he had no where to go. He didn't know anybody in Paris, but he went to the local, and asked where he could find me. They gave him an address and he came up to see me.
